root: ^You don’t look back, but you feel the weight of the town behind you—its walls, its people, its secrets fading with every step forward.
^The path ahead takes you into the lowlands, toward a region known only as The Swamp. Mist clings to the air, and the light grows dim even in daylight.
^Your boots squish against the soft earth as the terrain grows wetter, wooden planks lining parts of the path to keep travelers above the muck.
^Then, a voice pierces the stillness—sharp, panicked.
^Down the path, you spot a lone figure, flailing, surrounded by writhing slimes.
